description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402] Logs emitted by one contract in a block range of at most 2000 blocks, optionally filtered by topics. Refuses (rather than truncates) when more than 1000 logs match, so an answer is always complete.

address.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

chain.description: EVM CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453, or a bare chain id number as a string. Chain names are refused.

title: EVM event logs (bounded)
